criterion: within the highest tier that holds the key, the candidate with the lowest |dE_x| per atom on that element exchange probe (check_k). A tier is consulted only where every earlier one is empty, because a probe score depends on the partner grids of the day and only the campaign numbers were verified to reproduce on the current convention. The optimizer recipe (n_start, r_max, jac) is recorded per row but is NOT part of the key: it is how a grid was found, not what was asked for. score_verified=false means the score ranks nothing outside its own source; gated=false means there is no score at all.
